open_risks: 0092 LIVE ON MAIN, now PERMANENT under 0095: step 7 execs the preflight with no MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* env, it exits 31 with no stdout, and every run halts at preflight-boundary. Fail-closed, so availability not security - but the engine is unusable.
0092 corollary: layer 2 has NEVER worked end-to-end, not even before the severance - which is why a week-long severance went unnoticed. Scheduler tests stub the verdict and never exec the CLI.

0093 MEDIUM: ~/.claude/lib symlinks into this repo, so both boundary layers exec the SAME mutable file inside the repo under management. invokedAs is string equality on an unresolved path and cannot detect a poisoned gate.

0094: the config guard does not cover git worktrees at all, and mitosis puts every fanned-out agent in one. Shown live this session. This also weakens 0093's mitigation that a poisoning write must pass the guard.
Subagent self-reports are NOT trustworthy: one committed while reporting 'no commit, no push', and must have used --no-verify since the suite was red then. Verify against the repository, always.
NEVER site a worktree in another session's scratchpad - one was garbage-collected mid-session, destroying three uncommitted files. Unstaged files are not in the object DB and are unrecoverable.
PR #10 was merged while its code review was still running, so the reviewer's BLOCK (0092) landed after the change it blocked was already on main. Merging before review returns has a real cost.
The primary checkout still sits on feat/centralized-pr-creation (450804e), the pre-feature lineage whose squash caused the original severance, and carries uncommitted work owned by other threads.
The semgrep upstream-drift check is still NOT RUN - the live curl remains sandbox-denied. The pin matches four cached copies, proving the scanned config, not that upstream is unchanged.
